seo.title: Iron Ore Supplier in Nepal
seo.description: Hematite iron ore from the Katujpani deposit, Makawanpur — supplied to Nepal's cement and metals industry. Request bulk supply or view the assay data.

hero.sub: Hematite iron ore from the Katujpani deposit, Makawanpur — supplied to Nepal's cement and metals industry.

cement.title: Hematite ore for cement plants
cement.body: An iron corrective for the raw mix: it adjusts the iron and silica moduli and acts as a flux.

foundry.title: Evaluation lots for foundry and metallurgical buyers
foundry.body: Supplied for evaluation and blending. Suitability depends on your grade requirements.

assay.title: Sampling and assay support
assay.body: Full assay sheets and samples are available on request.

project.title: An iron deposit in Makawanpur, mapped and sampled.
project.body: Katujpani lies in Bakaiya Gaupalika-09, Makawanpur District, Bagmati Province. Field mapping identified three deposit zones — Areas A, B and C — and grab, chip and channel sampling covered 62.55 m across five sections.

timeline.title: From field to supply.
timeline.intro: Each stage hands verified data to the next.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: Topographic and geological mapping of the lease area.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.body: Grab, chip and channel samples across the deposit zones.

assay.title: Laboratory assay
assay.body: Samples analysed for Fe, Fe₂O₃, SiO₂ and Al₂O₃.

permitting.title: Permitting
permitting.body: Mine scheme prepared under Department of Mines and Geology (DMG) guidelines.

extraction.title: Extraction
extraction.body: Planned quarrying within the approved area.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Ore supplied to cement plants and metals buyers.
